name: GARAGE MACHIDA Sakaigawa
card: Past the café: a slab-wood table and private rooms with lofts
title: GARAGE MACHIDA Sakaigawa — a “second place” with a café, eight minutes from Kobuchi Station
lead: GARAGE MACHIDA Sakaigawa is in Kiso-Higashi, Machida, an eight-minute walk from Kobuchi Station on the JR Yokohama Line. At the entrance is a serious café, GARAGE COFFEE; beyond it are a slab-wood table, wall-facing focus seats, L-shaped seats, private rooms and shared offices with lofts. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: JR Yokohama Line Kobuchi Station, 8 min walk
Single-slab wooden table / wall-facing focus seats / L-shaped work seats / private room / shared offices with lofts (3 rooms) / café
Drop-in ¥660/hour / DAY PLAN ¥16,390/month / FULL PLAN ¥21,890/month (incl. tax)
concept: A “second place” where anyone can be themselves
The official website describes it as “a ‘second place’ where anyone can be themselves” — the idea of creating somewhere close to home where you can focus on work.
The flow is to order a hand-drip specialty coffee at the café by the entrance, then work in the space at the back. Members can enjoy more than 40 kinds of drinks and snacks free of charge.
steps: A serious café at the door
At the entrance is the café GARAGE COFFEE, serving hand-drip specialty coffee and hot sandwiches.
Order a drink, then head through to the workspace at the back.
A slab-wood desk and wall-facing seats
The prized single-slab wooden table is a wide, solid desk.
There are also wall-facing focus seats with side screens, and L-shaped seats for several people.
A room for web meetings, shared offices with lofts
The private room suits web meetings or work you want to keep away from prying eyes.
The shared offices with lofts are just three exclusive rooms, from ¥89,800 a month (incl. tax).
A shared office with a loft

word.title: What is a loft?
body: A mezzanine-like space built into the upper part of a room, reached by ladder or stairs.
The official website notes that the shared offices at GARAGE MACHIDA Sakaigawa have lofts that can also be used for storage.

credits: © GARAGE MACHIDA (official website: “GARAGE MACHIDA Machida Sakaigawa”)

name: Coworking Space Breath
card: A glass-fronted ground floor with a childminding service
title: Coworking Space Breath — a glass-fronted ground floor you can bring children to, five minutes from the North Exit of Mitaka Station
lead: Coworking Space Breath is on a glass-fronted ground floor in Nakacho, Musashino, a five-minute walk from the North Exit of Mitaka Station. It has a lounge, working desks, a raised tatami-style area (koagari) and café seats, plus a childminding service (paid). Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Mitaka Station North Exit, 5 min walk
Lounge / working desks / koagari (raised seating area) / café seats / childminding space
Weekdays 9:00–20:00 (last entry 19:00) / Sat 10:00–17:00 / closed Sundays and holidays
concept: Making time to work, with your children along
Breath is a place for coworking and events. Seats for people working and a childminding service sit side by side on the same ground floor.
Part of the lounge can be entered with a pushchair, and there is a changing table and educational toys. It is reachable from Mitaka Station, or on foot from Kichijoji Station along Nakamichi-dori.
steps: The bright, glass-fronted exterior lets you see inside from the street.
Part of the lounge can be entered with a pushchair.
Laptop seats and wall-facing focus desks
There are seats for laptop work and wall-facing desks for focus.
A copier and a drinks corner are also available.
A service to watch over children
The childminding service costs ¥1,500 for one hour and ¥2,800 for two hours.
The childminding space is stocked with educational toys.
Educational toys in the childminding space

word.title: What is koagari?
body: A raised area of tatami or wooden flooring, one step above the main floor, where you sit.
The official website says Breath has a koagari space. Somewhere you can take off your shoes and sit is easy to use with children.

credits: Breath official website: “Mitaka Coworking Space Breath”

name: Share Office func
card: A shared office with sit-stand desks, designed and run by a Fuchu architecture firm
title: Share Office func — designed and run by architects, six minutes from Fuchu Station, “growing the joy of work with the town”
lead: Share Office func is on the 2nd floor of the Tama Building, a six-minute walk from Fuchu Station on the Keio Line. Designed and run by Our Design, a first-class architects' office based in Fuchu, it has coworking with 120 cm-wide sit-stand desks at every seat, six private rooms, and a meeting and event space. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Keio Line Fuchu Station, 6 min walk
Coworking space (120 cm sit-stand desk at every seat) / 6 rental offices (from 5.2 m²) / meeting room and event space
Drop-in ¥1,100/day (Tue, Thu, Sat 10:00–18:00) / all-day coworking ¥14,300/month / rental offices from ¥39,600/month
concept: Growing the joy of work with the town
The name func carries three meanings: fun (FUN), creative (Creative) and bringing a new function to the town (FUNCtion).

The official website lists three values: the individual, coworking and connection. Lose yourself in a lockable private room, collaborate at the big table, and connect with the area at members' meet-ups.
steps: Every seat in the coworking space has a 120 cm-wide sit-stand desk.
The all-day plan is ¥14,300 a month, and there are also weekday morning, afternoon and weekend/holiday plans.
There are six private rooms in all, from 5.2 m² and usable by one person.
They start at ¥39,600 a month and can also be used as a business address.
A place to connect with the town
The meeting room doubles as an event space.
Members' meet-ups and events with invited guests are held here.

word.title: What is a sit-stand desk?
body: A desk whose top can be raised and lowered, so you can work sitting or standing.
Every seat in func's coworking space has one.

credits: Our Design, first-class architects' office (officially described as “designed and run” by them)

name: BUSO AGORA
card: A community coworking space supporting start-ups and businesses, three minutes from Machida Station
title: BUSO AGORA — a community-based coworking and shared office on the 4th floor of AETA Machida, three minutes from Machida Station
lead: BUSO AGORA is on the 4th floor of AETA Machida, a three-minute walk from Machida Station on the Odakyu Line and JR Yokohama Line. With a free space, booth seats, single booths, private rooms for 2–3 and meeting rooms, it is a community-based coworking space and shared office. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Odakyu Line Machida Station East Exit / JR Yokohama Line Machida Station Central North Exit, 3 min walk
Free space / booth seats / single booths / private rooms for 2–3 / business meeting space / meeting rooms
Drop-in: free space ¥500/hour, ¥1,700/day; booth seats ¥2,800/day / monthly free space from ¥8,000
Members: weekdays 9:00–23:00, weekends & holidays 10:00–20:00 / drop-in: weekdays 10:00–17:00
concept: Supporting local start-ups and businesses
The official website presents BUSO AGORA as “a community-based coworking space and shared office supporting start-ups and businesses”.

It is registered with INCU Tokyo, the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's incubation-facility scheme, and offers start-up support programmes plus company registration and mailbox services. Lunchtime talks and other events give members chances to talk with one another.
steps: Spacious seating three minutes from the station
The free space costs ¥500 per hour, ¥1,100 for three hours and ¥1,700 per day.
Monthly free-space memberships range from ¥8,000 to ¥15,500.
Seats for one, rooms for small groups
Booth seats cost ¥2,800 per day. There are also single booths and private rooms for 2–3.
Private rooms range from ¥28,000 to ¥154,000 a month.
There is a business meeting space and a meeting room, which members can book.
Meetings with visitors can be held three minutes from the station.

word.title: What is incubation?
body: Nurturing newly founded companies and businesses with space and advice. The word originally means hatching eggs.
BUSO AGORA is registered with the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's INCU Tokyo scheme and runs a start-up support programme.

name: Cs TACHIKAWA
card: 24-hour coworking and three meeting rooms, five minutes from the South Exit of Tachikawa Station
title: Cs TACHIKAWA — 24/7 coworking and three meeting rooms for 12, five minutes from the South Exit of Tachikawa Station
lead: Cs TACHIKAWA is on the 2nd floor of the Sunny Building in Nishikicho, a five-minute walk from the South Exit of JR Tachikawa Station. It has a coworking space that monthly members can use 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, private workspaces and three rental meeting rooms each seating 12. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: JR Tachikawa Station South Exit, 5 min walk
Free seats / private-room area / Booth S / 3 rental meeting rooms (12 each; can be combined)
Coworking drop-in ¥660/hour / monthly from ¥22,000 / private workspace from ¥29,480/month / meeting rooms from ¥2,200/hour
Monthly members 24 hours, 365 days / drop-in weekdays 10:00–22:00 (reception weekdays 10:00–17:00)
concept: Opening up a place to work in Tachikawa
Cs TACHIKAWA is a shared office that can serve as a company office, a remote-work spot, a base for a new business or sales office, or a study room for qualifications.
Power, Wi-Fi, desks, chairs, a business-card scanner and a water server are free. It is also registered with the Tokyo Metropolitan Government's incubation-facility scheme, INCU Tokyo.
steps: There is a private-room area and Booth S; private workspaces start at ¥29,480 a month.
Address use and a virtual office (from ¥6,600 a month) are also available.
There are three rental meeting rooms, each seating 12, and all three can be combined.
Meeting rooms start at ¥2,200 per hour, or ¥1,100 per hour for monthly members.

word.title: What is a virtual office?
body: A service that gives you a business address and mail handling without renting an actual desk.
Cs TACHIKAWA offers a virtual office that allows company registration from ¥6,600 a month.

name: Coworking Space Hachioji 8Beat
card: An easygoing coworking space with bookshelves, on a 5th floor near the North Exit of Hachioji Station
title: Coworking Space Hachioji 8Beat — a neighbourhood coworking space from ¥500 for two hours, on the 5th floor of the Tonen Building
lead: Coworking Space Hachioji 8Beat is on the 5th floor of the Tonen Building in Misakicho, near the North Exit of Hachioji Station. At ¥500 for two hours or ¥1,000 a day, it is a relaxed neighbourhood coworking space. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Besides work, it is used for events, study sessions and students' self-study
concept: A neighbourhood coworking space near Hachioji Station
8Beat is a coworking space near Hachioji Station offering seats with Wi-Fi and power.
The official website says it is used not only by people working but also by event organisers, classes and students studying on their own.
steps: Drop-in costs ¥500 for two hours or ¥1,000 a day.
Seats come with Wi-Fi and power.
There are bookshelves on the floor, and you can read freely while at 8Beat.
Books to pick up between tasks give the place its character.

word.title: What is coworking?
body: People from different companies and jobs working side by side in the same place.
A small neighbourhood coworking space like 8Beat also becomes a venue for study sessions and events.

name: CoBREW KICHIJOJI
card: Over 50 seats on two floors, which turn into a members' bar some evenings
title: CoBREW KICHIJOJI — a “place for co-creation” with 50+ seats on two floors, five minutes from Kichijoji Station
lead: CoBREW is on the ground and 2nd floors of Wellbe's Kichijoji in Kichijoji-Honcho, a five-minute walk from Kichijoji Station. Split into a working space and an open space across two floors, it has more than 50 seats in all, with private rooms, fixed desks, web-meeting booths and two meeting rooms. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 1F free address / 2F free address, web-meeting booths, fixed desks, private rooms, meeting rooms A & B (50+ seats in total)
Drop-in ¥660/hour, ¥3,300/day (up to 8.5 hours) / free address ¥33,000/month / fixed desk ¥47,300/month / private room ¥66,000/month
concept: More people who want to work in this town
CoBREW's motto is “more people who want to work in this town”, and it aims to create a “place for co-creation” where people connect and new value is born.
It runs a community that brings together freelancers, start-ups and local companies, and holds consultations and regular study sessions. Some evenings, it becomes a community bar for members.
steps: Seats spreading either side of the entrance
The ground floor is a free-address area, with seats spreading out to the left and right of the entrance.
Drop-in is available on weekdays from 9:30 to 18:00, at ¥660 per hour.
The area to the left of the entrance
The area to the right of the entrance
A place to focus, up the stairs
As well as free-address seats, the 2nd floor has fixed desks and web-meeting booths.
Private rooms and two meeting rooms
The 2nd floor also has private rooms and meeting rooms A and B.
Private rooms are ¥66,000 a month. Projectors, monitors and whiteboards are available.

word.title: What is free address?
body: A system with no assigned seats: you choose any free seat to work.
CoBREW has free-address areas on both floors, available on the ¥33,000-a-month plan.

name: PORTAL POINT HARAJUKU
card: A whole-building creative office four minutes from Kita-sando Station, with 8th-floor coworking and a sky terrace
title: PORTAL POINT HARAJUKU — more than “just a place to work” — 8th-floor coworking and a sky terrace overlooking the National Stadium
lead: PORTAL POINT HARAJUKU is in Sendagaya, a four-minute walk from Kita-sando Station on the Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line and seven minutes from JR Harajuku Station. Real Gate has turned an entire building — one basement level and eight floors above ground — into offices under the concept “New Standard”. The 8th floor is a coworking space, and there is a sky terrace on the roof. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line Kita-sando Station, 4 min walk / JR Yamanote Line Harajuku Station, 7 min
1F shop / 2F–3F whole-floor offices / 4F–7F small offices / 8F coworking space / B1F storage rooms
concept: For grown-up creative workers who know how to play
The official website presents the building, under the concept “New Standard”, as a new kind of office that is not “just a place to work”, aimed at grown-up creative workers who know how to play.
Real Gate says it has been creating offices under the PORTAL POINT brand since 2012, with design that sets them apart from other coworking brands. Harajuku is the brand's flagship building.
steps: The 8th-floor coworking space has a conference zone, a relax zone, a mix zone and a booth zone.
Free desks come with or without company registration, and dedicated desks, meeting rooms and phone booths are on the same floor.
A rooftop overlooking the National Stadium and Meiji Jingu
The official website says the rooftop sky terrace looks out over the National Stadium and Meiji Jingu.
Somewhere to step outside for fresh air between tasks is right in the same building.
From a shop to small offices
The ground floor is a shop unit, floors 2–3 are whole-floor offices, floors 4–7 are small offices and the basement holds storage rooms.
You can start in coworking and move up to a private office or a whole floor in the same building.

word.title: What is PORTAL POINT?
body: An office brand that Real Gate has run since 2012. Its official website gives the theme as “New Modern”, offering distinctive design and service experiences.
There are sites in Shibuya, Yoyogi-Koen, Ebisu, Harajuku and elsewhere, each building with its own concept.

credits: © REALGATE (Real Gate official website: “PORTAL POINT HARAJUKU”)
PORTAL POINT official website: “PORTAL POINT HARAJUKU” / Real Gate official website: WORKS

name: PORTAL POINT SHIBUYA
card: 8th-floor free desks and a rooftop terrace in Jinnan, three minutes from Exit B1 of Shibuya Station
title: PORTAL POINT SHIBUYA — a creative office in Jinnan with 24-hour free desks on the 8th floor and a rooftop terrace
lead: PORTAL POINT SHIBUYA is in Jinnan 1-chome, a three-minute walk from Exit B1 of Shibuya Station. A creative office run by Real Gate, it has free desks on the 8th floor, small offices on the 3rd and 5th floors, and whole-floor offices on the 2nd, 4th, 6th and 7th floors. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Shibuya Station Exit B1, 3 min walk
8F free desks / 3F & 5F small offices (9.83–61.46 m²) / 2F, 4F, 6F & 7F whole-floor offices
Shared lounge / rooftop terrace / phone booths / hourly meeting rooms
concept: A place for self-realisation that treats the city as a playground
The official website says a new creative space has been born “in this city, where diverse values mix regardless of generation or culture, to stir the urge to create”.
The idea is a creative office where people gather as a “place for self-realisation”, treating ever-changing Shibuya as their playground while trying to reinvent themselves.
steps: The free desks are on the 8th floor and, according to the official website, available 24 hours.
The building also has a shared lounge and phone booths for online meetings.
Hourly meeting rooms are available for meetings.
Even on days with visitors, you can wrap things up inside the building.
From small offices to whole floors
Floors 3 and 5 have small offices from 9.83 m², and floors 2, 4, 6 and 7 have whole-floor offices of 158.63–218.27 m².
On the roof, a rooftop terrace lets you reset above the streets of Jinnan.

word.title: What is Jinnan?
body: A district of Shibuya City spreading north of Shibuya Station around Koen-dori.
PORTAL POINT SHIBUYA is in Jinnan 1-chome; the official website gives it as three minutes on foot from Exit B1 of Shibuya Station.

credits: © REALGATE (PORTAL POINT official website: “PORTAL POINT SHIBUYA”)
PORTAL POINT official website: “PORTAL POINT SHIBUYA”

name: PORTAL POINT Yoyogi-Koen
card: An “URBAN NATURAL” office one minute from Yoyogi-Hachiman Station, with a rooftop terrace overlooking Yoyogi Park
title: PORTAL POINT Yoyogi-Koen — “URBAN NATURAL” — a work lounge and rooftop terrace where you feel the breeze from Yoyogi Park
lead: PORTAL POINT Yoyogi-Koen is a one-minute walk from Yoyogi-Hachiman Station on the Odakyu Line and two minutes from Yoyogi-Koen Station on the Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line. Completed in October 2020, the seven-storey building has free desks on the 4th floor, small offices with balconies on floors 4–7, and shops on the ground floor. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Odakyu Line Yoyogi-Hachiman Station, 1 min walk / Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line Yoyogi-Koen Station, 2 min
4F free desks / 4F–7F 17 private small offices (all with balconies) / 1F 2 shop units
Work lounge / rooftop terrace / garden terrace / hourly meeting rooms
concept: URBAN NATURAL
The official website says that, under the concept “URBAN NATURAL”, the building — where you can feel the breeze from Yoyogi Park — livens up the whole area.
All 17 small offices have balconies, and throughout the building you can feel close to fresh air and greenery.
steps: The official website describes an open work lounge that can be used for meetings or as a workspace.
Free desks are on the 4th floor, with plans that do or do not include company registration.
A rooftop and garden overlooking Yoyogi Park
There is a rooftop terrace overlooking Yoyogi Park, and a garden terrace.
The official website calls them “perfect for recharging”.
Floors 4–7 have 17 small offices of 29.40–55.97 m², all with balconies.
Visitors can be met in the hourly meeting rooms.

word.title: What does “URBAN NATURAL” mean?
body: The concept phrase of PORTAL POINT Yoyogi-Koen.
The official website says the aim is a building where you feel the breeze from Yoyogi Park, livening up the whole area.

credits: © REALGATE (PORTAL POINT official website: “PORTAL POINT Yoyogi-Koen”)
PORTAL POINT official website: “PORTAL POINT Yoyogi-Koen”
